chapter: New Orleans bands, Oliver and Armstrong
title: Joe Oliver blowing outside against Freddie Keppard
summary: Rose confirms the story of Oliver walking out and blowing a B-flat blues with Richard M. Jones at the piano to draw the crowd from Keppard's club. He then turns to the Albert system clarinet.
